caption: The drawing depicts a single bird, specifically an eagle, with its wings fully spread out horizontally. The eagle is rendered in shades of gold and brown, with darker tones along the edges and underparts of the feathers, creating a sense of depth and dimension. The feathers on the wings are detailed with individual segments clearly defined. The eagle’s body is centrally positioned, with its talons extended downward and close together, and its head is turned slightly to its left. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color with some small brown stains or marks scattered around, and there is a signature in the bottom right corner. The overall composition is centered with the eagle occupying the main focus of the image.
title: Eagle
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
